name: plan-window
description: In the plan window only, shows plan's issues in the Explorer, opens an issue's Claude terminal, shell and ticket, and opens plan browse's pages in the integrated browser. Other windows ignore it.

plan.issuesFile.description: plan's issues file: one issue key per line, one Issues item each. Matches issuesFile in plan's config.

plan.command.description: The plan CLI the window runs to clear an issue's colour (plan pulse <KEY> off).

plan.pulsesFile.description: plan's pulses file: <KEY>=orange or <KEY>=green lines that colour the Issues items. Matches pulsesFile in plan's config.

plan.workspaceDir.description: Where plan start writes plan.code-workspace and each issue's <KEY>.code-workspace. The window on plan.code-workspace is the plan window, the only one this extension acts in; each <KEY>.code-workspace is read for its worktree, ticket and prompt. Matches workspaceDir in plan's config.
